overall_evaluation_summary.segment_level_primary_result: At the recommended high_and_moderate threshold, the RAG detects 2 of 3 positive reasoning segments with no false alarms (hit rate 0.6667; F1 0.8).
overall_evaluation_summary.strict_label_plus_mechanism_result: Strict instance-level identification has 0 true positives at every threshold because all three predictions use non-equivalent labels, despite correct localization and strong mechanisms.
overall_evaluation_summary.mechanism_first_result: Mechanism-first identification reaches 2 of 3 hidden instances at high_and_moderate and all 3 when the candidate tier is included, with no instance-level false positives.
overall_evaluation_summary.candidate_tier_value_assessment: The density-selection candidate is a useful marginal detection: it supplies the missing mechanism-first match at the fourth threshold, while its anchoring label prevents a strict match.
main_failure_modes: Systematic near-neighbor taxonomy substitution for the hidden labels.
The Satisficing instance is withheld from identified findings and appears only as a candidate.
main_strengths: All findings and the candidate are correctly localized to the relevant decision episodes.
The identified mechanisms are fully supported by valid interview quotations.
The analysis explicitly discloses that retrieved corpus support was unavailable and preserves a non-bias interpretation for the candidate.
overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: This run shows strong evidence localization and mechanism recovery but a complete strict-taxonomy failure. The gap between strict and mechanism-first scores is entirely attributable to label taxonomy mismatch; candidate inclusion recovers the remaining mechanism at the fourth threshold without increasing false alarms.
